ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: MDPs, Reinforcement Learning. Prerequisites: ECE 534. The course will discuss techniques to solve dynamic optimization problems where the system dynamics are unknown. The course will first introduce dynamic programming techniques for Markov decision problems and then focus on solving the dynamic programming equations approximately when the underlying parameters of the Markov chain are unknown. While the emphasis will be on techniques for which one can prove performance bounds, heuristics used in reinforcement learning will also be presented to show their relationship to existing theory, and to identify open theoretical problems.
